papers.title: High-Resolution Uplink Sensing in Millimeter-Wave ISAC Systems
papers.authors: L. Zhao, Z. Ni, Y. Feng, J. Li, X. Bu, and J. Andrew Zhang

summary.zh: 从毫米波上行通信中，估计目标的角度、距离与速度。
summary.en: Estimating angles, ranges, and velocities from millimeter-wave uplink signals.

question.zh: 基于毫米波混合阵列的上行感知框架。
question.en: An uplink sensing framework based on millimeter-wave hybrid arrays.

overview.zh: 代码仿真了一个基于毫米波混合阵列的上行感知框架，用于高精度目标参数估计。仿真场景包含具有不同距离、速度和到达角的静态目标与动态目标。系统首先进行高分辨率到达角估计，再利用基于到达角的二维 FFT-MUSIC（AB2FM）算法估计目标参数。
overview.en: The code simulates an uplink sensing framework based on millimeter-wave hybrid arrays, enabling high-precision target parameter estimation. The simulation generates a scene with static and dynamic targets, each with different distances, velocities, and angles of arrival (AoA). The system first performs high-resolution AoA estimation followed by AoA-based 2D-FFT-MUSIC (AB2FM) for target parameter estimation.

text.zh: 基于频域平滑的 MUSIC 算法进行高分辨率到达角估计。
text.en: High-resolution AoA estimation using MUSIC based on frequency-domain smoothing.

text.zh: 支持 Bartlett、零空间、SINR 优化以及混合波束形成策略。
text.en: Multiple beamforming strategies, including Bartlett, Null-Space, SINR optimization, and hybrid approaches.

title.zh: 多普勒与时延联合估计

text.zh: 利用基于到达角的二维 FFT-MUSIC（AB2FM）算法，联合估计目标的多普勒与时延。

codeNote.zh: MATLAB 仿真包含角度估计、波束形成与时延—多普勒估计。Main.m 设置场景，Params.m 配置阵列和信号参数。
codeNote.en: The MATLAB simulation includes angle estimation, beamforming, and delay–Doppler estimation. Main.m sets up the scenario; Params.m configures the array and signal parameters.

papers.title: Passive Sensing for Multiple Vehicles in Bi-Static ISAC Systems
papers.authors: L. Zhao, Y. Feng, Z. Ni, and X. Bu

summary.zh: 在时钟不同步的双基地系统中，感知多辆车的运动。
summary.en: Sensing multiple vehicles in a bistatic system with unsynchronized clocks.

question.zh: 双基地通信感知一体化系统中的多车辆被动感知。
question.en: Passive sensing of multiple vehicles in a bi-static ISAC system.

overview.zh: 代码仿真了一个双基地通信感知一体化（ISAC）系统，用于对多辆车进行被动感知。主要包括用于快拍扩增的前后向平滑算法、结合周期图与 MUSIC 的 SWIP-MUSIC 时偏估计，以及基于周期图的多普勒与时延联合估计。
overview.en: The code simulates a bi-static Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) system for passive sensing of multiple vehicles. It includes forward-backward smoothing for snapshot augmentation, SWIP-MUSIC combining periodogram and MUSIC methods for time-offset estimation, and periodogram-based joint Doppler–delay estimation.

text.zh: 利用前后向平滑（FBS）算法扩增快拍。
SWIP-MUSIC 结合周期图与 MUSIC 方法进行时偏估计。
text.en: SWIP-MUSIC combines periodogram and MUSIC methods for time-offset estimation.

title.zh: 多普勒与时延联合估计

text.zh: 利用基于周期图的算法，联合估计多普勒与时延。
text.en: Joint Doppler–delay estimation using periodogram-based algorithms.

codeNote.zh: 从 main.m 运行仿真，在 params.m 中调整参数。仓库还包含会议演示的 LaTeX 源文件与 PDF。
codeNote.en: Run main.m to start the simulation and adjust parameters in params.m. The repository also includes the conference presentation as LaTeX source and PDF.

summary.en: Combining QC-LDPC code structure and overlapping decoding in a transceiving system.
